'''Confessor Group''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] often tasked with leading other squadrons in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The unit was named after a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] martial arts melee weapon called a "[[confessor's whip]]." Confessor Group was equipped with [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class starfighters]] armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and outfitted with enhanced [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] targeting systems.

==Behind the scenes==
Confessor Group was represented as a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.
